summary.short: Draft Nanjing municipal regulation on AI industry development and application. It sets coordination mechanisms, government support for R&D, industry, talent and funds, public-sector AI use and procurement, data and compute support, sandbox pilots, and conduct rules for AI developers and providers. Effective date is unspecified (202X).
summary.long: Draft municipal regulation (征求意见稿) applying to AI science and technology innovation, industry development, application integration and safety governance within Nanjing's administrative area (Art. 3). Chapters cover: a city coordination mechanism and an expert advisory committee (Arts. 5, 7); support for basic research, key technology, platforms and talent (Arts. 11-15, 48); industry development priorities, enterprise cultivation including OPC enterprises, and platform and chain-leader enterprises (Arts. 16-27); sectoral application duties for manufacturing, agriculture, energy, consumption, education, healthcare, transport and government services (Arts. 28-40); preferential public procurement of safe and reliable AI products (Art. 29); factor support for data, computing power and algorithms (Arts. 41-44); financial support, funds and insurance (Arts. 45-47); and safety governance. Safety governance includes government AI safety supervision (Art. 53), a sandbox mechanism allowing limited trial operation with suspension or termination on major risk (Art. 54), a list of prohibited AI products and conduct, including price discrimination and deepfake misuse (Art. 55), a ban on abuse of dominance by chain-leader and platform enterprises (Art. 56), algorithmic fairness assessment and explanation duties in public management, healthcare, finance and judicial areas (Art. 57), and ethics review (Art. 58). The draft sets no fines or penalty amounts, and its effective date is blank (Art. 59).

notes: Draft for public comment (征求意见稿). The effective date is blank ('202X年XX月XX日', Art. 59). Several provisions defer to unspecified rules ('按照规定', '按照国家和省有关规定', and Art. 55(5) '国家禁止的行为'). The text uses 'OPC企业（含OTC企业）' without defining OPC or OTC. The draft contains no penalty or enforcement provision for the prohibitions in Art. 55. Cross-references to other instruments are limited to the two relation rows above.

thresholds.note: The draft (征求意见稿) states no numeric cutoff that changes legal treatment. The only numerals are a placeholder effective date (Art. 59, "202X年XX月XX日"), a cross-reference to Art. 31 of the Government Procurement Law (Art. 29), and program or project names (e.g., Arts. 30, 48). Size categories such as small and medium enterprises, specialised 'little giant' firms and OPC firms appear in Arts. 21, 23 and 56 without any numeric or delegated size test in this text.
